Shop Men Shop Women Quick shop Explore the Full Lineup Men Women Kids New Arrivals Sunwear Powered by Bamboo Tops Bottoms Hats & Accessories Graphics Fishing Travel Swim View All Powered By Bamboo SUSTAINABLE LOW-IMPACT After years of hunting down better performance fabrics, we came across bamboo—a regenerative material loaded with natural performance benefits. Since 2011, we’ve been using it to craft our seriously soft sunwear. Feel the Bamboo Difference MEET THE TEAM Team Free Fly Big-wave surfers. Dedicated anglers. World champions. Team Free Fly is stacked with hard-charging athletes and inspiring humans that put our gear to the test day in and day out. Charlie Mogul Fishing Guide, Waterman Get to Know Him Madison Wittich Fishing Guide Get To Know Her Evan Geiselman Pro Surfer, Fly Fisherman Get to Know Him Nicole Gormley Filmmaker, Waterwoman Get to Know Her Eli Iorg Fly Fisherman, Creator Get to Know Him Danielle Davidson Fishing Guide Get to Know Her Benny Blanco Fishing Guide, Conservationist Get to Know Him Explore the Roster FEATURED ARTICLE As Good As It Gets Bull reds. Blown forecasts. Louisiana marsh country. We spent three days exploring the marsh with Captain Charlie Mogul and quickly learned why so many anglers keep coming back. Read Now BEHIND THE DESIGN Inside The Free Fly x Trout Unlimited Partnership From Idaho rivers to grassroots conservation efforts nationwide, dive into the story behind this limited-edition collaboration and the mission driving it forward. Read The Full Story FEATURED ARTICLE Dispatch: Big Island After a busy season of cookbook writing, documentary making, and storytelling projects, Nicole Gormley was ready for a different kind of adventure. Follow the filmmaker and waterwoman to Hawaii's Big Island, where a weather-window spearfishing mission, wild places, and life off the grid offered a much-needed reset. Read Now FEATURED ARTICLE Restless by Nature Some people know how to sit still. Cam Richards and Evan Geiselman aren't those people. Raised on the East Coast, both came up chasing waves in places most surfers overlook. That same restless energy still drives them today—whether they're surfing, fishing, traveling, or hitting the most famous breaks on the North Shore. Read Now FEATURED ARTICLE SUNSET, AGAIN Emi Erickson lives a quiet life on the North Shore. The seasons don't really change there—just the direction of the swell, the light, the way the wind rises in the afternoon. She spends plenty of time on the road, but when the winter swell starts to show up, everything in her world quietly centers around Sunset Beach. Read Now FEATURED ARTICLE FLOW STATE Baja has a way of stripping things back. Away from civilization. No crowds, no schedule, no pressure. Just the rhythm of the tides, the relentless sun, and a stretch of coastline that quietly demands your attention. For Rachael Tilly, three-time WSL World Champion, a few days in Baja became something more than a surf trip. Read Now FEATURED ARTICLE The Two Sides of Baja What happens when you drop a bunch of salty, feral athletes and anglers onto the Baja peninsula with only a loose plan and a couple tanks of gas? After a winter spent holed up, that’s exactly what we did. We hightailed it to Baja to chase the kind of weirdness you only find in the chaos and heatwaves of the desert—a mashup of dusty roads, cacti, and trippy coastal views. Read Now FEATURED ARTICLE Training for the World's Biggest Waves Watch as legendary big-wave surfer, Mark Healey, trains and prepares for once-in-a-lifetime swells. Read Now Filters: Featured View All Wild Comfort. JOIN OUR COMMUNITY FOLLOW ALONG @FREEFLYAPPAREL WE'RE CATCHING ON With a featherweight design, ridiculously soft, stretchy fabric, and a UPF 25+ rating, the Elevate Lightweight Hoodie is guaranteed to become your new go-to. Quick shop Free Fly launched the Topogrid Pant earlier this spring, and it instantly became our go-to pant. Quick shop Few brands in the fly-fishing realm are making more comfortable, well-fitting clothes than Free Fly. And that holds true for the Bamboo Shade Hoodie II. Quick shop The Reverb Short might just be the short of the summer, with versatility for pretty much anything you can dream up—indoors & outdoors. Quick shop The Bamboo Shade Hoodie is the perfect do-everything shirt for the summer. Quick shop I almost always reach for my Breeze Flats Pant. They’re breezy, breathable, and have a slightly tapered leg that stays down under waders or looks cute on their own. Quick shop These Leggings are a great weight; breathable and comfortable. Great fit for all seasons. Quick shop Need Help?
